exceptions.title: does not dismiss with the escape key that ends a composition spanning a reopen
exceptions.reason: The case asserts that Escape directly after `compositionend` keeps the popup open. Only WebKit sends `compositionend` before the `keydown` that ends a composition, so only WebKit needs that window. In the other engines Vase UI closes the popup (`BUG-6158`). The case "ignores Escape for 5 ms after compositionend in WebKit" tests the window in WebKit.

exceptions.title: does not dismiss when clicking portaled children
exceptions.reason: The case presses a plain button in a portal in the popup. Vue gives that event to no listener of the popup element, so that button is outside the popup. A press in a child popup that `Teleport` moved is inside (`VUE-4`). The case "VUE-4: a press in a child popup that Teleport moved does not close the parent popup" tests that press.

exceptions.title: focus management in nested lists
exceptions.reason: Base UI runs the case only in jsdom. jsdom does not focus the first item at the open, and a browser does, so the keys of the case reach other items in a browser. In the block `lists below the list in the component tree`, the cases open a list below with its key, in a browser, and the first item of that list gets the focus.

exceptions.title: keyboard navigation in nested menus lists
exceptions.reason: Base UI runs the case only in jsdom. jsdom does not focus the first item at the open, and a browser does, so the keys of the case reach other items in a browser. The case `moves in a grid of a list below, and closes that list for Escape` of the block `lists below the list in the component tree` makes the same moves in a browser.

exceptions.title: keyboard navigation in nested menus with different orientation
exceptions.reason: Base UI runs the case only in jsdom. jsdom does not focus the first item at the open, and a browser does, so the keys of the case reach other items in a browser. The cases of `VUE-46` in the block `lists below the list in the component tree` press the close key of a list below a horizontal list, in a browser. The list below closes, and the list above moves its highlight.

exceptions.title: prop getters are memoized
exceptions.reason: `setup` runs one time, so the composable makes the getters one time and their identity cannot change. React makes new getters when a props object of the list changes. A new case covers the half that applies: a getter reads the current props of an entry that changes.
